type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A10_nonunique_forbids_collapse
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (h : (resolutionSet σ e).length ≠ 1) : collapseOp σ e = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A11_local_noncontradiction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ¬ satisfies { equations

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A15_monotone_refinement
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ σ' : State) (e : Expr) (hext : σ'.extends σ) (hadm : collapseAdmissible σ e) : σ'.constraints.length > 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A16_collapse_idempotent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : collapseOp σ e = some v) : collapseOp σ (.term (.cst v)) = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A1_existence_base
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∃ _ : IndetConst, True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A2_existence_classes
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ _ : IndetConst, True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A3_not_classical_real
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (i : IndetConst) (c : ClassicalConst), Term.indt i ≠ Term.cst c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A4_not_classical_complex
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (i : IndetConst) (c : ClassicalConst), Term.indt i ≠ Term.cst c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A5_distinct_from_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (i : IndetConst) (c : ClassicalConst) : Term.indt i ≠ Term.cst c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A6_extended_operators
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ op : ClassicalOp, ∃ extOp : ExtendedOp, extOp = .extended op

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A7_extension_coincides_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (op : ClassicalOp) (t₁ t₂ : Term) (h₁ : t₁.isClassical = true) (h₂ : t₂.isClassical = true) : (Term.app (.classical op) t₁ t₂).isClassical = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.A9_unique_resolution_implies_collapse
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v : ClassicalConst) (h : resolutionSet σ e = [v]) : collapseOp σ e = some v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.Collapse_unique
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (e : Expr) (σ : State) (v₁ v₂ : ClassicalConst) (h₁ : Collapse e σ = some v₁) (h₂ : Collapse e σ = some v₂) : v₁ = v₂

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.classical_reduction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Formula) (h : universallyValid φ) : classicallyValid φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_uniqueness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (σ : State) (e : Expr) (v₁ v₂ : ClassicalConst) (h₁ : collapseOp σ e = some v₁) (h₂ : collapseOp σ e = some v₂) : v₁ = v₂

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.indet_isolation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Formula) (σ : State) (hφ : ∀ c ∈ σ.constraints, c.sym = .block) : satisfies σ (.atom .top)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_A10
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hnone : res Σ φ = none) : collapse res Σ φ = φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_A8
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hcl : classicalFrag φ) : collapse res Σ φ = φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_A9
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (hres : res Σ φ = some v) : collapse res Σ φ = syntacticCollapse (some v) φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_classical_fragment_stable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hcl_res : ∀ v, res Σ φ = some v → res Σ (syntacticCollapse (some v) φ) = some v) : ∀ ψ : IndeterminateExpr, classicalFrag ψ → collapse res Σ ψ = ψ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_div_zero_form
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e : IndeterminateExpr) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (hform : Σ.equations.any (fun eq => eq.lhs == IndeterminateExpr.indeterminate && eq.rhs == binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = true) (res_correct : res Σ (binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = some v) : collapse res Σ (binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_idempotent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hstable : ∀ v, res Σ φ = some v → res Σ v = some v) : collapse res Σ (collapse res Σ φ) = collapse res Σ φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_implies_rewrite_star
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (res : MetaArithmeticState → IndeterminateExpr → Option IndeterminateExpr) (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ v : IndeterminateExpr) (hcol : collapse res Σ φ = v) (hv : classicalFrag v) : RewriteStar Σ φ v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse_recovery
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (res_correct : res Σ indeterminate = some v) : collapse res Σ indeterminate = v
